Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Definition varEI : Set := var.

Definition blame_label : Set := var.

Inductive modality : Set :=
 | mod_unsafe : modality
 | mod_safe : modality
 | mod_non_nullable : modality  .

Inductive label : Set :=
 | label_name (l:blame_label)
 | label_not_label (l:blame_label)  .

Inductive typ : Set :=
 | typ_null : typ
 | typ_mod_arrow (M:modality) (T:typ) (U:typ)  .

Inductive trm : Set :=
 | t_var_b (_:nat)
 | t_var_f (x:var)
 | t_null : trm
 | t_abs (T:typ) (t:trm)
 | t_app (s:trm) (t:trm)
 | t_app_safe (f:trm) (s:trm) (t:trm)
 | t_cast (s:trm) (V:typ) (p:label) (T:typ)  .

Inductive typI : Set :=
 | typI_null : typI
 | typI_unsafe_arrow (Ti:typI) (Ui:typI)  .

Inductive typE : Set :=
 | typE_null : typE
 | typE_nonnull_arrow (Te:typE) (Ue:typE)
 | typE_safe_arrow (Te:typE) (Ue:typE)  .

Inductive mode : Set :=
 | mode_explicit : mode
 | mode_implicit : mode  .

Inductive trmEI : Set :=
 | tei_var_b (_:nat)
 | tei_var_f (xei:varEI)
 | tei_null (m:mode)
 | tei_abs_exp (Te:typE) (tei:trmEI)
 | tei_abs_imp (Ti:typI) (sei:trmEI) (Ui:typI)
 | tei_app (sei:trmEI) (tei:trmEI) (m:mode)
 | tei_app_safe (sei:trmEI) (tei:trmEI) (uei:trmEI) (m:mode)
 | tei_cast_exp (sei:trmEI) (Ve:typE) (Te:typE)
 | tei_cast_imp (sei:trmEI) (Vi:typI) (p:label) (Ti:typI)
 | tei_import_exp (Te:typE) (tei:trmEI) (Ti:typI) (uei:trmEI)
 | tei_import_imp (Ti:typI) (tei:trmEI) (Te:typE) (uei:trmEI)  .

Definition ctxE : Set := list ( atom * typE ).

Definition ctxI : Set := list ( atom * typI ).

Fixpoint open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec (k:nat) (tei_5:trmEI) (tei__6:trmEI) {struct tei__6}: trmEI :=
  match tei__6 with
  | (tei_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => tei_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => tei_5
        | inright _ => tei_var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (tei_var_f xei) => tei_var_f xei
  | (tei_null m) => tei_null m
  | (tei_abs_exp Te tei) => tei_abs_exp Te (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec (S k) tei_5 tei)
  | (tei_abs_imp Ti sei Ui) => tei_abs_imp Ti (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec (S k) tei_5 sei) Ui
  | (tei_app sei tei m) => tei_app (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec k tei_5 sei) (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec k tei_5 tei) m
  | (tei_app_safe sei tei uei m) => tei_app_safe (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec k tei_5 sei) (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec k tei_5 tei) (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec k tei_5 uei) m
  | (tei_cast_exp sei Ve Te) => tei_cast_exp (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec k tei_5 sei) Ve Te
  | (tei_cast_imp sei Vi p Ti) => tei_cast_imp (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec k tei_5 sei) Vi p Ti
  | (tei_import_exp Te tei Ti uei) => tei_import_exp Te (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec k tei_5 tei) Ti (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec (S k) tei_5 uei)
  | (tei_import_imp Ti tei Te uei) => tei_import_imp Ti (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec k tei_5 tei) Te (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec (S k) tei_5 uei)
end.

Definition open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI tei_5 tei__6 := open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec 0 tei__6 tei_5.

Inductive isExplicit : trmEI -> Prop :=
 | exp_var : forall (xei:varEI),
     isExplicit (tei_var_f xei)
 | exp_null :
     isExplicit (tei_null mode_explicit)
 | exp_abs : forall (L:vars) (Te:typE) (tei:trmEI),
      ( forall xei , xei \notin  L  -> isExplicit  ( open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI tei (tei_var_f xei) )  )  ->
     isExplicit (tei_abs_exp Te tei)
 | exp_app : forall (sei tei:trmEI),
     isExplicit sei ->
     isExplicit tei ->
     isExplicit (tei_app sei tei mode_explicit)
 | exp_safe_app : forall (sei tei uei:trmEI),
     isExplicit sei ->
     isExplicit tei ->
     isExplicit uei ->
     isExplicit (tei_app_safe sei tei uei mode_explicit)
 | exp_cast : forall (tei:trmEI) (Ve Te:typE),
     isExplicit tei ->
     isExplicit (tei_cast_exp tei Ve Te)
 | exp_import : forall (L:vars) (Te:typE) (tei:trmEI) (Ti:typI) (uei:trmEI),
     isImplicit tei ->
      ( forall xei , xei \notin  L  -> isExplicit  ( open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI uei (tei_var_f xei) )  )  ->
     isExplicit (tei_import_exp Te tei Ti uei)
with isImplicit : trmEI -> Prop :=
 | imp_var : forall (xei:varEI),
     isImplicit (tei_var_f xei)
 | imp_null :
     isImplicit (tei_null mode_implicit)
 | imp_abs : forall (L:vars) (Ti:typI) (tei:trmEI) (Ui:typI),
      ( forall xei , xei \notin  L  -> isImplicit  ( open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI tei (tei_var_f xei) )  )  ->
     isImplicit (tei_abs_imp Ti tei Ui)
 | imp_app : forall (sei tei:trmEI),
     isImplicit sei ->
     isImplicit tei ->
     isImplicit (tei_app sei tei mode_implicit)
 | imp_safe_app : forall (sei tei uei:trmEI),
     isImplicit sei ->
     isImplicit tei ->
     isImplicit uei ->
     isImplicit (tei_app_safe sei tei uei mode_implicit)
 | imp_cast : forall (tei:trmEI) (Vi:typI) (p:label) (Ti:typI),
     isImplicit tei ->
     isImplicit (tei_cast_imp tei Vi p Ti)
 | imp_import : forall (L:vars) (Ti:typI) (tei:trmEI) (Te:typE) (uei:trmEI),
     isExplicit tei ->
      ( forall xei , xei \notin  L  -> isImplicit  ( open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI uei (tei_var_f xei) )  )  ->
     isImplicit (tei_import_imp Ti tei Te uei).

Inductive nullify : typI -> typE -> Prop :=
 | nullify_null :
     nullify typI_null typE_null
 | nullify_arrow : forall (Vi Ti:typI) (Ve Te:typE),
     nullify Vi Ve ->
     nullify Ti Te ->
     nullify (typI_unsafe_arrow Vi Ti) (typE_safe_arrow Ve Te).

Inductive erase : typE -> typI -> Prop :=
 | erase_null :
     erase typE_null typI_null
 | erase_arrow1 : forall (Ve Te:typE) (Vi Ti:typI),
     erase Ve Vi ->
     erase Te Ti ->
     erase (typE_safe_arrow Ve Te) (typI_unsafe_arrow Vi Ti)
 | erase_arrow2 : forall (Ve Te:typE) (Vi Ti:typI),
     erase Ve Vi ->
     erase Te Ti ->
     erase (typE_nonnull_arrow Ve Te) (typI_unsafe_arrow Vi Ti).

Inductive compatI : typI -> typI -> Prop :=
 | compatI_null_refl :
     compatI typI_null typI_null
 | compatI_null : forall (Ti1 Ti2:typI),
     compatI typI_null (typI_unsafe_arrow Ti1 Ti2)
 | compatI_arrow : forall (Vi Ti Vi' Ti':typI),
     compatI Vi' Vi ->
     compatI Ti Ti' ->
     compatI (typI_unsafe_arrow Vi Ti) (typI_unsafe_arrow Vi' Ti').

Inductive ssub : typE -> typE -> Prop :=
 | ssub_null :
     ssub typE_null typE_null
 | ssub_null_arrow : forall (Ve Te:typE),
     ssub typE_null (typE_safe_arrow Ve Te)
 | ssub_arrow1 : forall (Ve Te Ve' Te':typE),
     ssub Ve' Ve ->
     ssub Te Te' ->
     ssub (typE_nonnull_arrow Ve Te) (typE_nonnull_arrow Ve' Te')
 | ssub_arrow2 : forall (Ve Te Ve' Te':typE),
     ssub Ve' Ve ->
     ssub Te Te' ->
     ssub (typE_nonnull_arrow Ve Te) (typE_safe_arrow Ve' Te')
 | ssub_safe_arrow : forall (Ve Te Ve' Te':typE),
     ssub Ve' Ve ->
     ssub Te Te' ->
     ssub (typE_safe_arrow Ve Te) (typE_safe_arrow Ve' Te').

Inductive typingE : ctxE -> trmEI -> typE -> Prop :=
 | typingE_var : forall (Ge:ctxE) (xei:varEI) (Te:typE),
      uniq  Ge  ->
      binds  xei Te Ge  ->
     typingE Ge (tei_var_f xei) Te
 | typingE_null : forall (Ge:ctxE),
      uniq  Ge  ->
     typingE Ge (tei_null mode_explicit) typE_null
 | typingE_abs : forall (L:vars) (Ge:ctxE) (Ve:typE) (sei:trmEI) (Te:typE),
      ( forall xei , xei \notin  L  -> isExplicit  ( open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI sei (tei_var_f xei) )  )  ->
      ( forall xei , xei \notin  L  -> typingE  (( xei ~ Ve )++ Ge )   ( open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI sei (tei_var_f xei) )  Te )  ->
     typingE Ge (tei_abs_exp Ve sei) (typE_nonnull_arrow Ve Te)
 | typingE_app : forall (Ge:ctxE) (sei tei:trmEI) (Te Ve:typE),
     isExplicit sei ->
     isExplicit tei ->
     typingE Ge sei (typE_nonnull_arrow Ve Te) ->
     typingE Ge tei Ve ->
     typingE Ge (tei_app sei tei mode_explicit) Te
 | typingE_safe_app : forall (Ge:ctxE) (fei sei tei:trmEI) (Te Ve:typE),
     typingE Ge fei (typE_safe_arrow Ve Te) ->
     typingE Ge sei Ve ->
     typingE Ge tei Te ->
     typingE Ge (tei_app_safe fei sei tei mode_explicit) Te
 | typingE_cast : forall (Ge:ctxE) (sei:trmEI) (Ve Te:typE),
     isExplicit sei ->
     typingE Ge sei Ve ->
     ssub Ve Te ->
     typingE Ge  ( (tei_cast_exp sei Ve Te) )  Te
 | typingE_import : forall (L:vars) (Ge:ctxE) (Te:typE) (tei:trmEI) (Ti:typI) (uei:trmEI) (Ve:typE),
     isImplicit tei ->
      ( forall xei , xei \notin  L  -> isExplicit  ( open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI uei (tei_var_f xei) )  )  ->
      ( forall xei , xei \notin  L  -> typingE  (( xei ~ Te )++ Ge )   ( open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI uei (tei_var_f xei) )  Ve )  ->
     typingI  nil  tei Ti ->
     nullify Ti Te ->
     typingE Ge  ( (tei_import_exp Te tei Ti uei) )  Ve
with typingI : ctxI -> trmEI -> typI -> Prop :=
 | typingI_var : forall (Gi:ctxI) (xei:varEI) (Ti:typI),
      uniq  Gi  ->
      binds  xei Ti Gi  ->
     typingI Gi (tei_var_f xei) Ti
 | typingI_null : forall (Gi:ctxI),
      uniq  Gi  ->
     typingI Gi (tei_null mode_implicit) typI_null
 | typingI_abs : forall (L:vars) (Gi:ctxI) (Vi:typI) (sei:trmEI) (Ti:typI),
      ( forall xei , xei \notin  L  -> isImplicit  ( open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI sei (tei_var_f xei) )  )  ->
      ( forall xei , xei \notin  L  -> typingI  (( xei ~ Vi )++ Gi )   ( open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI sei (tei_var_f xei) )  Ti )  ->
     typingI Gi  ( (tei_abs_imp Vi sei Ti) )   ( (typI_unsafe_arrow Vi Ti) )
 | typingI_app : forall (Gi:ctxI) (sei tei:trmEI) (Ti Vi:typI),
     isImplicit sei ->
     isImplicit tei ->
     typingI Gi sei (typI_unsafe_arrow Vi Ti) ->
     typingI Gi tei Vi ->
     typingI Gi (tei_app sei tei mode_implicit) Ti
 | typingI_safi_app : forall (Gi:ctxI) (fei sei tei:trmEI) (Ti Vi:typI),
     isImplicit fei ->
     isImplicit sei ->
     isImplicit tei ->
     typingI Gi fei (typI_unsafe_arrow Vi Ti) ->
     typingI Gi sei Vi ->
     typingI Gi tei Ti ->
     typingI Gi (tei_app_safe fei sei tei mode_implicit) Ti
 | typingI_cast : forall (Gi:ctxI) (sei:trmEI) (Vi:typI) (p:label) (Ti:typI),
     isImplicit sei ->
     typingI Gi sei Vi ->
     compatI Vi Ti ->
     typingI Gi (tei_cast_imp sei Vi p Ti) Ti
 | typingI_import : forall (L:vars) (Gi:ctxI) (Ti:typI) (tei:trmEI) (Te:typE) (uei:trmEI) (Vi:typI),
     isExplicit tei ->
      ( forall xei , xei \notin  L  -> isImplicit  ( open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI uei (tei_var_f xei) )  )  ->
      ( forall xei , xei \notin  L  -> typingI  (( xei ~ Ti )++ Gi )   ( open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI uei (tei_var_f xei) )  Vi )  ->
     typingE  nil  tei Te ->
     erase Te Ti ->
     typingI Gi  ( (tei_import_imp Ti tei Te uei) )  Vi.

Require Export Definitions.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Notation "t '⦂' S '=>' U '@@' p" := (t_cast t S p U) (at level 40).

Notation "M '{{{' T '→' U '}}}'" := (typ_mod_arrow M T U) (at level 40).

Notation "##" := mod_non_nullable.

Notation "??" := mod_safe.

Notation "!!" := mod_unsafe.

Notation Null := typ_null.

Notation "### T '→' U" := (typE_nonnull_arrow T U) (at level 40).

Notation "??? T '→' U" := (typE_safe_arrow T U) (at level 40).

Notation "!!! T '→' U" := (typI_unsafe_arrow T U) (at level 40).

Definition neglabel_fun (l: label) : label :=
  match l with
  | (label_name l') => (label_not_label l')
  | (label_not_label l') => label_name l'
  end.

Inductive null_mod : modality -> Prop :=
| null_mod_safe : null_mod ??
| null_mod_unsafe : null_mod !!.

Inductive psub : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| psub_null_refl : psub Null Null
| psub_null M S T : null_mod M -> psub Null (M {{{S → T}}})
| psub_arrow_nn M S T S' T' : nsub S' S -> psub T T' -> psub (## {{{S → T}}}) (M {{{S' → T'}}})
| psub_arrow_nullable M M' S T S' T' : null_mod M -> null_mod M' -> nsub S' S -> psub T T' -> psub (M {{{S → T}}}) (M' {{{S' → T'}}})

with nsub : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
     | nsub_null_refl : nsub Null Null
     | nsub_null S T : nsub Null (?? {{{S → T}}})
     | nsub_arrow_nn M S T S' T' : psub S' S -> nsub T T' -> nsub (## {{{S → T}}}) (M {{{S' → T'}}})
     | nsub_arrow_nullable M S T S' T': psub S' S -> nsub T T' -> nsub (!! {{{S → T}}}) (M {{{S' → T'}}})
     | nsub_arrow_nullable_safe M S T S' T': (M = ## \/ M = ??) -> psub S' S -> nsub T T' -> nsub (typ_mod_arrow ?? S T) (typ_mod_arrow M S' T').

Notation "T '≺+' U" := (psub T U) (at level 40).

Notation "T '≺-' U" := (nsub T U) (at level 40).

Notation "~~ p" := (neglabel_fun p) (at level 40).

Inductive sfor : trm -> label -> Prop :=
| sfor_varb n p : sfor (t_var_b n) p
| sfor_var x p : sfor (t_var_f x) p
| sfor_null p : sfor t_null p
| sfor_abs T s p : sfor s p -> sfor (t_abs T s) p
| sfor_app t1 t2 p : sfor t1 p -> sfor t2 p ->  sfor (t_app t1 t2) p
| sfor_safe_app t1 t2 t3 p : sfor t1 p -> sfor t2 p -> sfor t3 p -> sfor (t_app_safe t1 t2 t3) p
| sfor_cast_pos S T p s : S ≺+ T -> sfor s p -> sfor (s ⦂ S => T @@ p) p
| sfor_cast_neg S T p s : S ≺- T -> sfor s p -> sfor (s ⦂ S => T @@ (neglabel_fun p)) p
| sfor_cast_diff S T p q s : sfor s p -> p <> q -> p <> (neglabel_fun q) -> sfor (s ⦂ S => T @@ q) p.
=== TASK ===
From Stdlib Require Import List.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Blame.

Notation "G '⊢e' t ':' T" := (typingE G t T) (at level 40, t at level 59).

Notation "G '⊢i' t ':' T" := (typingI G t T) (at level 40, t at level 59).

Fixpoint desugarTe (Te : typE) : typ :=
  match Te with
  | typE_null => typ_null
  | typE_nonnull_arrow Se Ue => typ_mod_arrow ## (desugarTe Se) (desugarTe Ue)
  | typE_safe_arrow Se Ue => typ_mod_arrow ?? (desugarTe Se) (desugarTe Ue)
  end.

Fixpoint desugarTi (Ti : typI) : typ :=
  match Ti with
  | typI_null => typ_null
  | typI_unsafe_arrow Si Ui => typ_mod_arrow !! (desugarTi Si) (desugarTi Ui)
  end.

Notation dTe Te := (desugarTe Te).

Notation dTi Ti := (desugarTi Ti).

Definition fresh_label (existing : list blame_label) : blame_label := MetatheoryAtom.Atom.fresh existing.

Definition E_l := fresh_label nil.

Definition I_l := fresh_label (E_l :: nil).

Definition E_intl := fresh_label (E_l :: I_l :: nil).

Definition I_intl := fresh_label (E_l :: I_l :: E_intl :: nil).

Definition E_lab := label_name E_l.

Definition I_lab := label_name I_l.

Definition E_int := label_name E_intl.

Definition I_int := label_name I_intl.

Definition EIlabels := E_lab ::
                       I_lab ::
                       ~~E_lab ::
                       ~~I_lab ::
                       E_int ::
                       I_int ::
                       ~~E_int ::
                       ~~I_int ::
                       nil.

Notation SafeLabels :=
  (~~I_lab :: E_lab :: I_int :: ~~I_int :: E_int :: ~~E_int :: nil).

Fixpoint desugar t :=
  match t with
  | tei_var_b n =>
    t_var_b n
  | tei_var_f x =>
    t_var_f x
  | tei_null _ =>
    t_null
  | tei_abs_exp T t =>
    t_abs (desugarTe T) (desugar t)
  | tei_abs_imp Ti t Ui =>
    t_cast (t_abs (desugarTi Ti) (desugar t))
           (typ_mod_arrow ## (desugarTi Ti) (desugarTi Ui))
           I_int
           (typ_mod_arrow !! (desugarTi Ti) (desugarTi Ui))
  | tei_app t u _ =>
    t_app (desugar t) (desugar u)
  | tei_app_safe s t u m =>
    t_app_safe (desugar s) (desugar t) (desugar u)
  | tei_cast_exp t Te Ue =>
    t_cast (desugar t) (desugarTe Te) E_int (desugarTe Ue)
  | tei_cast_imp t Ti p Ui =>
    t_cast (desugar t) (desugarTi Ti) p (desugarTi Ui)
  | tei_import_exp Te t Ti u =>
    t_app (t_abs (desugarTe Te) (desugar u))
          (t_cast (desugar t) (desugarTi Ti) I_lab (desugarTe Te))
  | tei_import_imp Ti t Te u =>
    t_app (t_abs (desugarTi Ti) (desugar u))
          (t_cast (desugar t) (desugarTe Te) E_lab (desugarTi Ti))
  end.

Fixpoint labels t :=
  match t with
  | tei_var_b _ => nil
  | tei_var_f _ => nil
  | tei_null _ => nil
  | tei_abs_exp _ t => labels t
  | tei_abs_imp _ t _ => labels t
  | tei_app t u _ => labels t ++ labels u
  | tei_app_safe s t u _ => labels s ++ labels t ++ labels u
  | tei_cast_exp t Te Ue => labels t
  | tei_cast_imp t Ti p Ui => p :: labels t
  | tei_import_exp Te t Ti u => labels t ++ labels u
  | tei_import_imp Ti t Te u => labels t ++ labels u
  end.

Definition disjoint {A} (l1 l2 : list A) :=
  forall x, In x l1 -> ~(In x l2).

Notation sfors t ls := (forall l, In l ls -> sfor t l).

Theorem explicit_cant_be_blamed :
  (forall Ge t Te,
      Ge ⊢e t : Te ->
      disjoint EIlabels (labels t) ->
      sfors (desugar t) SafeLabels) /\
  (forall Gi t Ti,
      Gi ⊢i t : Ti ->
      disjoint EIlabels (labels t) ->
      sfors (desugar t) SafeLabels).

(** * Labels are invariant under opening with a variable *)

Lemma labels_open_var : forall t k x,
  labels (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec k (tei_var_f x) t) = labels t.
Proof.
  induction t as
    [ n | x0 | m
    | T s IHs
    | Ti s IHs Ui
    | s IHs t IHt m
    | s IHs t IHt u IHu m
    | s IHs Ve Te
    | s IHs Vi p Ti
    | Te s IHs Ti u IHu
    | Ti s IHs Te u IHu ];
    intros k x0.
  - cbn [open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec labels].
    destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[?|?]|?]; reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - cbn [open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec labels]. rewrite IHs. reflexivity.
  - cbn [open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec labels]. rewrite IHs. reflexivity.
  - cbn [open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec labels]. rewrite IHs, IHt. reflexivity.
  - cbn [open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec labels]. rewrite IHs, IHt, IHu. reflexivity.
  - cbn [open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec labels]. rewrite IHs. reflexivity.
  - cbn [open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec labels]. rewrite IHs. reflexivity.
  - cbn [open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec labels]. rewrite IHs, IHu. reflexivity.
  - cbn [open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI_rec labels]. rewrite IHs, IHu. reflexivity.
Qed.

(** * Rule lemmas for [Psafe] *)

Lemma Psafe_var_f : forall x, Psafe (tei_var_f x).
Proof. intros x. unfold Psafe, disjoint. intros _ l Hl. apply sfors_var_f. Qed.

Lemma Psafe_null_e : Psafe (tei_null mode_explicit).
Proof. unfold Psafe, disjoint. intros _ l Hl. apply sfors_null. Qed.

Lemma Psafe_null_i : Psafe (tei_null mode_implicit).
Proof. unfold Psafe, disjoint. intros _ l Hl. apply sfors_null. Qed.

Lemma Psafe_app : forall s t m, Psafe s -> Psafe t -> Psafe (tei_app s t m).
Proof.
  intros s t m Hs Ht. unfold Psafe, disjoint in *. intros Hdis l Hl.
  apply sfor_app.
  - apply Hs. { intros y Hy Hy2. apply (Hdis y Hy). apply in_app_iff. auto. }
    exact Hl.
  - apply Ht. { intros y Hy Hy2. apply (Hdis y Hy). apply in_app_iff. auto. }
    exact Hl.
Qed.

Lemma Psafe_app_safe : forall f s t m,
  Psafe f -> Psafe s -> Psafe t -> Psafe (tei_app_safe f s t m).
Proof.
  intros f s t m Hf Hs Ht. unfold Psafe, disjoint in *. intros Hdis l Hl.
  apply sfor_safe_app.
  - apply Hf. { intros y Hy Hy2. apply (Hdis y Hy). apply in_app_iff. auto. } exact Hl.
  - apply Hs. { intros y Hy Hy2. apply (Hdis y Hy). apply in_app_iff. auto. } exact Hl.
  - apply Ht. { intros y Hy Hy2. apply (Hdis y Hy). apply in_app_iff. auto. } exact Hl.
Qed.

Lemma Psafe_cast_exp : forall s Ve Te, Psafe s -> ssub Ve Te -> Psafe (tei_cast_exp s Ve Te).
Proof.
  intros s Ve Te Hs Hsub. unfold Psafe, disjoint in *. intros Hdis l Hl.
  apply sfor_cast_both.
  - apply ssub_psub. exact Hsub.
  - apply ssub_nsub. exact Hsub.
  - apply Hs. exact Hdis. exact Hl.
Qed.

Lemma Psafe_cast_imp : forall s Vi p Ti, Psafe s -> Psafe (tei_cast_imp s Vi p Ti).
Proof.
  intros s Vi p Ti Hs. unfold Psafe, disjoint in *. intros Hdis l Hl.
  apply sfor_cast_user.
  - exact Hl.
  - intro Hp. exact (Hdis p Hp (or_introl eq_refl)).
  - apply Hs. { intros y Hy Hy2. apply (Hdis y Hy). right. exact Hy2. } exact Hl.
Qed.

Lemma Psafe_abs_exp : forall L Ve s Te,
  (forall x, x \notin L -> Psafe (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI s (tei_var_f x))) ->
  Psafe (tei_abs_exp Ve s).
Proof.
  intros L Ve s Te IH. unfold Psafe, disjoint in *. intros Hdis.
  destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
  assert (Hds : sfors (desugar s) SafeLabels).
  { apply (sfors_desugar_open_inv s 0 x).
    apply (IH x Hx). intros y Hy Hy2. rewrite labels_open_var in Hy2. exact (Hdis y Hy Hy2). }
  intros l Hl. apply sfor_abs. exact (Hds l Hl).

Lemma Psafe_abs_imp : forall L Vi s Ti,
  (forall x, x \notin L -> Psafe (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI s (tei_var_f x))) ->

Proof.

  destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].

  { apply (sfors_desugar_open_inv s 0 x).
    apply (IH x Hx). intros y Hy Hy2. rewrite labels_open_var in Hy2. exact (Hdis y Hy Hy2). }
  intros l Hl. apply sfor_cast_both.
  - apply psub_NN_U.
  - apply nsub_NN_U.
  - apply sfor_abs. exact (Hds l Hl).
Qed.

Lemma Psafe_import_exp : forall L Te s Ti u,
  Psafe s ->
  (forall x, x \notin L -> Psafe (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI u (tei_var_f x))) ->
  nullify Ti Te ->
  Psafe (tei_import_exp Te s Ti u).
Proof.
  intros L Te s Ti u Hs Hu Hnull. unfold Psafe, disjoint in *. intros Hdis.
  assert (Hds : forall y, In y EIlabels -> ~ In y (labels s)).
  { intros y Hy Hy2. apply (Hdis y Hy). apply in_app_iff. auto. }
  assert (Hdu : forall y, In y EIlabels -> ~ In y (labels u)).
  { intros y Hy Hy2. apply (Hdis y Hy). apply in_app_iff. auto. }
  destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
  assert (Hdus : sfors (desugar u) SafeLabels).
  { apply (sfors_desugar_open_inv u 0 x).
    apply (Hu x Hx). intros y Hy Hy2. rewrite labels_open_var in Hy2. exact (Hdu y Hy Hy2). }
  intros l Hl. apply sfor_app.
  - apply sfor_abs. exact (Hdus l Hl).
  - apply sfor_cast_nsub_only.
    + apply nullify_nsub. exact Hnull.
    + intro H; apply notin_I_lab_SafeLabels. rewrite <- H. exact Hl.
    + apply Hs. exact Hds. exact Hl.
Qed.

Lemma Psafe_import_imp : forall L Ti s Te u,
  Psafe s ->
  (forall x, x \notin L -> Psafe (open_trmEI_wrt_trmEI u (tei_var_f x))) ->
  erase Te Ti ->
  Psafe (tei_import_imp Ti s Te u).
Proof.
  intros L Ti s Te u Hs Hu Her. unfold Psafe, disjoint in *. intros Hdis.
  assert (Hds : forall y, In y EIlabels -> ~ In y (labels s)).
  { intros y Hy Hy2. apply (Hdis y Hy). apply in_app_iff. auto. }
  assert (Hdu : forall y, In y EIlabels -> ~ In y (labels u)).
  { intros y Hy Hy2. apply (Hdis y Hy). apply in_app_iff. auto. }
  destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
  assert (Hdus : sfors (desugar u) SafeLabels).
  { apply (sfors_desugar_open_inv u 0 x).
    apply (Hu x Hx). intros y Hy Hy2. rewrite labels_open_var in Hy2. exact (Hdu y Hy Hy2). }
  intros l Hl. apply sfor_app.
  - apply sfor_abs. exact (Hdus l Hl).
  - apply sfor_cast_psub_only.
    + apply erase_psub. exact Her.
    + intro H; apply notin_negE_lab_SafeLabels. rewrite <- H. exact Hl.
    + apply Hs. exact Hds. exact Hl.
Qed.

## How the proof works

The target is a conjunction proved by mutual induction on the two typing relations. Key ingredients added to `Task.v`:

1. **`Psafe t := disjoint EIlabels (labels t) -> sfors (desugar t) SafeLabels`**, so the goal becomes `(∀Ge t Te, Ge ⊢e t : Te -> Psafe t) ∧ (∀Gi t Ti, Gi ⊢i t : Ti -> Psafe t)`.

2. **Combined mutual induction scheme** (`Scheme typingE_mut ... with typingI_mut ...` then `Combined Scheme typing_mutind`). The default `typingE_ind` gives no IH for the cross-relation premises (e.g. the `typingI` subderivation inside `typingE_import`), so the combined scheme is essential.

3. **Subtyping transport through desugaring**:
   - `ssub_pn`, `nullify_pn`, `erase_pn`: `ssub` transports to `psub`/`nsub` in the same direction; `nullify`/`erase` give `psub (dTe Te) (dTi Ti)` and `nsub (dTi Ti) (dTe Te)` (the asymmetry explains why `SafeLabels` omits `~~E_lab`).
   - `sub_refl`: reflexivity of `psub`/`nsub` (mutual, via a joint conjunction).

4. **`sfor` decomposition and replacement lemmas** (`sfor_cast_inv`, `sfor_cast_replace`, app/abs analogues). These let the opening lemma peel a desugared *opened* term and rebuild the *unopened* one using the subtyping witness already embedded in the `sfor` proof, so no typing derivation is needed under binders.

5. **`sfors_desugar_open_inv`**: `sfors (desugar (open t x)) SafeLabels -> sfors (desugar t) SafeLabels`, plus `labels_open_var`, used to handle the `∀x ∉ L` binder premises by picking a fresh atom (`atom_fresh`).

6. **Label facts**: from `Atom.fresh_not_in`, all four fresh atoms `E_l, I_l, E_intl, I_intl` are pairwise distinct; hence the designated safe labels never coincide with the inserted labels (`I_lab`, `E_lab`, `I_int`, `E_int`) or their negations. `label_eq_dec` (via `Atom.eq_dec`) keeps the generic cast-insertion lemmas clean.

7. **Six `sfor` goals per constructor** are discharged by case analysis on `In l SafeLabels`, using `sfor_cast_pos/neg/diff` with the transported subtyping facts or with the disjointness hypothesis for user labels (`sfor_cast_user`).
